integrity: Mathematical proof and actual finite numerical validation included; the spherical reduction is classical and not itself asserted original. Targeted prior comparisons do not imply independent certification or proof of uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Real standard-Gaussian exact-arithmetic Nyström, one weak positive eigenvalue, r-1 sketch columns on rank-r matrix. No additional oversampling, multiple weak eigenvalues, complex sketches, roundoff, correlated sampling or growing-rank limit.
title: A universal half-moment transition for unoversampled Gaussian Nyström error
